# STUNTDATE

> STUNTDATE is a humans-only, 24-hour gig platform. Everyday people create out-of-the-ordinary gigs for one another, in real life or over FaceTime. A real human (a "Stuntdate", your wingman) does the gig and gets paid the same day. It is a gig site, not a dating site. AI works behind the scenes and never takes a gig.

STUNTDATE is currently a beta trial. People sign up, post and take gigs, and pay each other directly with whatever payment app they use.

## Pages
- [Home](https://stuntdate.com/): what STUNTDATE is, how it works, FAQ, and the beta sign-up
- [About](https://stuntdate.com/about): why humans only, and who is behind it
- [Real gigs](https://stuntdate.com/real-gigs): 46 real gigs from real people, past requests that show the kind of thing people post
- [Privacy](https://stuntdate.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://stuntdate.com/terms)

## Key facts
- Tagline: "You're the gig." and "IRL & FaceTime for bed rotters"
- Motto: "Human first, educated at birth. The world is not our algorithm."
- How it works: 1) A person creates a gig and sets the price. 2) A Stuntdate goes for the gig, does it, and gets paid the same day.
- Humans only: no bots take gigs and no AI does the work
- Adults only: 18+ during the beta
- Contact: julie@stuntdate.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stuntdate/
